summary: Frontend-only structural verification of the Capo console reorganization from 6 CapoGroup accordions into 7 always-visible SecBlock sections. Full flow tested: PublicGate -> AdminGate PIN 198505 -> Onboarding (panificio) -> Sign in as Capo -> auth (admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026!). All 7 sections present in exact required order, sticky jump-nav and FAB scroll correctly, no leftover legacy subtabs or accordion toggles, subtabs-pianoai preserved and clickable, all Section 5/7 panels render, no horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390 widths, no uncaught runtime page errors.
console_observations: Only 401 responses from some background API fetches (likely unauthenticated data endpoints, unrelated to console reorg)
THREE.Clock deprecation warnings and WebGPU adapter-not-available warnings (3rd party three.js, non-blocking)
No React runtime errors or component-throw stack traces observed
critical_code_review_comments: Multiple 401s in background fetches are noisy — main agent may want to gate those API calls on auth state to reduce console noise.
THREE.Clock deprecation warnings originate from a dependency; consider upgrading three.js usage if it becomes intrusive.
